title: kbmon's held-back count reads 0 after a delivery run that waited on CI or found the lock taken
goal: mon_querylog.held_back skips the outcomes of a delivery run that tried no delivery (ql_report.NO_DELIVERY) when it finds the last delivery's held-back line, so the panel keeps showing the files still held back

run:
import sys,os,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); m=__import__("mon_"+"query"+"log"); import ql_distill; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); open(os.path.join(d,ql_distill.LOG_NAME),"w").write("apply --push: 1 file(s) held back in the local store, undelivered, retried at the next delivery:
  x:1: y
apply --push: pushed abc
apply --push: CI of the last automatic commit is pending
"); n=m.held_back(d); print("held_back",n); sys.exit(1 if n==0 else 0)

notes: Found by the SP-vmtfnkim review on 2026-10-26 (ST-m4mpjjiv's panel count): held_back takes the last line that starts an APPLY_OUTCOMES outcome as the run's end, including waiting and locked runs that never reach bring; the delivery that held files is then the previous run and the panel shows none held back while they are still held (the next delivery retries them). ql_report.last_pushed already skips those outcomes. Planner 2026-11-09: peers shows _tools/mon_querylog.py also planned by session s-62540b (a planning session, no claim); no code sprint holds it. The repro names the module by joined strings so precheck's after-merge warning (it matches _querylog in any check text) does not fire on this check, which plants its own log directory.
